How a job with B.C. actually goes

Three steps, one person handling all of them — from the first phone call to the system running in your house.

01

Free consultation

Joel comes out, looks at your space and your existing equipment, and tells you straight what it actually needs — not what's easiest to sell.

02

Custom install

Equipment sized to your home, permits pulled where required, ductwork done properly. No shortcuts, no subcontracted crews you've never met.

03

Long-term care

Maintenance and repairs down the road come from the same person who installed it — not a call center routing you to whoever's free.

Services

25 years in the trade. One name on the invoice.

Joel Butler learned heating and air conditioning the way most good tradespeople do — in attics, crawlspaces, and every kind of San Diego rooftop, long before he opened B.C. Mechanical.

He still does the estimating, the installing, and the follow-up himself. That means the person who designs your system is the same person who shows up when you need it serviced five years later.
